semantics.request.capture: Capture the exact user request before model execution and bind it to the active turn.
semantics.evidence.snapshot: Create a canonical, reproducible snapshot of requirements, claims, source changes, verification, and artifacts.
semantics.reviewer.spawn: Start one native reviewer thread identified separately from the executor thread.
semantics.reviewer.isolation: Give the reviewer only the canonical snapshot under a host-enforced read-only policy, without executor reasoning history.
semantics.reviewer.observe_completion: Observe reviewer start and terminal output with stable thread identity and no transcript-format dependency.
semantics.audit.receipt: Validate structured per-requirement outcomes and persist an Ed25519-signed, hash-bound audit receipt outside model authority.
semantics.completion.block: Prevent a completion claim when the audit receipt is missing, stale, non-passing, or uncertified.
semantics.runtime.bootstrap: Validate loop state, plugin identity, adapter identity, runtime version, and certification before goal work.
